system: You are an ambitious AI PhD student who is looking to publish a paper that will contribute significantly to the field.
task_description: Your task is to develop a computational model that can identify marker genes for a qPCR assay. The qPCR assay should be able to quantify the proportion of a dedicated cell type in an RNA sample. Marker genes should be identified from scRNA-Seq datasets as combinations of genes that are most indicative and quantitatively informative for a given cluster (i.e. cell type). In addition to marker genes, adequate baseline or reference genes should be selected for normalization of qPCR measurements. The performance of the selected marker panels should be evaluated using ROC curves and appropriate quantitative metrics. Make reasonable assumptions about potential confounders and investigate effects such as very high or very low cell-type proportions using dedicated simulations and statistical approaches in order to define realistic scenarios for how the markers would perform in practice. Generate plots that visualize the key analyses. Use the provided input_single_cell.h5ad dataset to develop and evaluate the algorithm.
